name: matchday-hero
title: Matchday hero
description: A club's opening on matchday: the next fixture with both teams, kick-off and tickets, a countdown inside a week, and the last five results.
docs: Pass the fixture: competition, home and away (a name and an optional logo; the initials stand in for a missing crest), kickoff as an ISO string with its offset, and venue. The kick-off is written in timeZone, the venue's own, as a time element. When it is less than a week away a countdown in days and hours appears in the corner of the card, worked out in the browser so the server never prints a stale one; pass now to fix the moment for previews and tests. form is the last results, oldest first (result, opponent, score, and short, a few letters such as "WAN" that are set under the score): the last five are shown, Win, Draw and Loss are spelled out for screen readers, and the opponent is said in full after the score and shown as a tooltip, so leave short out and the chip and the score stand alone. position is { rank, league, points? }. Set fixture.status to "live" with a score and a minute and the card shows the score with Live in words, and ticketsHref gives way to liveHref as Watch live. Pass hourCycle and locale, and labels (ordinals and points take a form for each plural category of your language).
